title: Tensor-Hom adjunction for modules over a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space (a topological space with a sheaf of commutative rings on its opens) and $\mathcal A,\mathcal G,\mathcal F$ $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ be the tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with $t_W:\mathcal A(W)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(W)}\mathcal G(W)\to(\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)(W)$ the components of the sheafification map, and $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ the sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom]; for $\eta\in\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_W}(\mathcal G|_W,\mathcal F|_W)$ write $\eta_{W'}:\mathcal G(W')\to\mathcal F(W')$ ($W'\subseteq W$ open) for its components. Then for every $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ there is a unique $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\tilde\varphi:\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ with $\tilde\varphi_W(t_W(a\otimes g))=(\varphi_W(a))_W(g)$ for all opens $W$, $a\in\mathcal A(W)$, $g\in\mathcal G(W)$, and $\varphi\mapsto\tilde\varphi$ is a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A,\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F))\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ of $\mathcal O_X(X)$-modules, natural in $\mathcal A$ (for $\alpha:\mathcal A'\to\mathcal A$: $\widetilde{\varphi\circ\alpha}=\tilde\varphi\circ(\alpha\otimes\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal G})$).

proof.text: Construct the correspondence as a composite of fullyFaithfulForget.homEquiv, the inverse of PresheafOfModules.homObjEquiv G.val A.val F.val, precomposition with the inverse presheaf braiding, the inverse sheafification adjunction homEquiv, and precomposition with tensorObjIsoSheafification.hom. This is an actual equivalence, so both inverse laws and bijectivity are inherited from the proved equivalences; no choice from existence is used.

Evaluate the sheafification adjunction apply_symm_apply identity on a pure tensor. Cancel tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv followed by .hom using inv_hom_id. Presheaf braiding swaps the two tensor factors, and tensorHomUncurry evaluates the local internal-Hom section. This proves correspondence_eval, exactly the displayed evaluation formula.

For pure_tensor_ext, cancel the epimorphism tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv, apply injectivity of the sheafification adjunction homEquiv, and use Adjunction.homEquiv_unit. PresheafOfModules.hom_ext and ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext reduce equality to all pure tensors. The evaluation formula then gives the requested uniqueness.

Prove correspondence_add and correspondence_smul using pure_tensor_ext and correspondence_eval. Addition is componentwise. For scalar compatibility, homModule acts by postcomposition with sectionsSMul; use sectionsSMul_app_apply, smul_app and overSections_coe_apply, with identity restriction at Over.mk (identity). Bundle the equivalence and these two equalities as a LinearEquiv.

For correspondence_natural, whiskerRight_tensorObjIsoSheafification_hom from the proved source MonoidalClosed module gives naturality of the tensor comparison. Combine it with naturality of the sheafification unit to show that alpha tensor identity carries the image of a pure tensor to the image of alpha(a) tensor g. Apply pure_tensor_ext and correspondence_eval. Finally supply the LinearEquiv family, evaluation, uniqueness, and this naturality to the unchanged existential statement.
